name: Daily brief generation
description: Operator asks for a quick state-of-the-day. Tests Nick's structured-output discipline.

messages.content: give me a 30-second brief on where things stand

contextSetup: Assume 5 active missions · last 24h had 2 wins (1 close · 1 cron-fix) · 1 friction point (a stuck task on the inbox)

judgeCriteria.description: Reply is scannable in ~30 seconds (bullets, short lines, no wall of prose)
Brief covers both progress (wins) AND blockers (friction), not just one side
No filler intros ('Here is your brief:'), no closing fluff ('Let me know if you need more details!')

expectedBehavior: Best case: 3-5 line dense brief with section markers. Acceptable: clear short paragraphs. Failure: 6-paragraph essay or generic 'things are going well' summary.
